key_models.description: Stateless dispatcher for OdooBot logic. No stored fields. No mail.thread or mail.channel inheritance.
Adds odoobot_state (Selection, 8 values) and odoobot_failed (Boolean) fields.
Adds _message_post_after_hook and execute_command_help hooks to invoke mail.bot._apply_logic.

odoobot_identity.note: OdooBot reuses the system/root partner. No separate res.users record with a bot flag.

odoobot_state_field.note: Value 'onboarding_attachement' has one-t spelling — exact value in source. NULL/False is treated as not_initialized in logic.

onboarding_init.first_message: Hello,\nOdoo's chat helps employees collaborate efficiently. I'm here to help you discover its features.\nTry to send me an emoji :)

onboarding_steps.failure_response: Not exactly. To continue the tour, send an emoji: type :) and press enter.
Not sure what you are doing. Please, type / and wait for the propositions. Select help and press enter.
Sorry, I am not listening. To get someone's attention, ping him. Write @OdooBot and select me.

onboarding_steps.side_effect: Creates mail.canned.response({'source': 'Thanks', 'substitution': 'Thanks for your feedback. Goodbye!'})
onboarding_steps.failure_response: To send an attachment, click on the paperclip icon and select a file.

onboarding_steps.side_effect: Deletes the temporary mail.canned.response created in previous step

tour_restart.condition: odoobot_state in (False, 'idle', 'not_initialized') and 'start the tour' in body
tour_restart.response: To start, try to send me an emoji :)

active_channel_scope.group_channels: ignored unless OdooBot explicitly pinged (not implemented in base)

key_finding: mail_bot is a stateless AbstractModel that hooks into discuss.channel post-message events; OdooBot reuses base.partner_root (not a dedicated bot user); per-user onboarding state is tracked in res.users.odoobot_state with 8 selection values across a 5-step linear feature-discovery sequence.
